name: io.github.cryptoduke01/gloam
title: Gloam
description: Private stablecoin payments for people and AI agents on mainnet, hosted or local with limits.

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Default network for tools: tempo-mainnet, robinhood-mainnet, base-mainnet, ethereum-mainnet, elysium-mainnet or bnb-mainnet (mainnet; Solana has its own gloam_solana_* tools, and Starknet its gloam_starknet_* tools, not open on Gloam yet); tempo, robinhood, base or ethereum (testnet; elysium for Elysium testnet once its pool is in; robinhood is the default when unset).

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's key. With GLOAM_TEMPO_ACCOUNT it is a Tempo access key bound by the owner's onchain limits. Optional: without it the tools only read and plan.

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_AGENT_SOLANA_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's Solana keypair (a keypair file's JSON array, or base58) for the gloam_solana_* tools. It opens the same private account the Gloam app opens for that wallet. Optional: without it the Solana tools only read.

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_STARKNET_ACCOUNT_INDEX
environmentVariables.description: Which private Starknet account GLOAM_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY opens for the gloam_starknet_* tools (default 0): the same account the Gloam app opens for that wallet. Starknet is not open on Gloam yet.

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_TEMPO_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: The owner's Tempo account that authorized the agent key in the AccountKeychain.

environmentVariables.name: GLOAM_NOTE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 32 random bytes in hex that encrypt the server's note store.
